candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.role_title: Intern Near Patient Care Research and Early Development
letter.opening: I am applying for the internship in Near Patient Care Research and Early Development. Turning noisy measurement data into clean features and testing models rigorously is what I enjoy most, and applying it to wearables for patient care is work I would be proud of.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence and a strong focus on machine learning.

achievements.impact: I preprocessed retinal OCT scans (denoising, resizing, augmentation) and fine-tuned an EfficientNet-B0 to 94.11% accuracy on a 968-image test set
in my thesis team I built the pipeline that aligns model-detected events with video timestamps, and in industry I analysed machine data on efficiency and downtime
I built an evaluation harness for my RAG project and documented every failure and its cause

letter.problems_section: I would screen literature and studies, prepare wearable data and build regression models, and report clearly to the cross-functional team. I have no sensor or wearable domain experience and have not used gradient boosting libraries in a project, so I would learn both from your scientists.
letter.closing: I am willing to relocate to Mannheim and can start in February 2027. As a non-EU student I will agree the internship length with you so it fits my permitted working days. I would be glad to discuss the role.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
